translations.web: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”
translations.bsb: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
translations.kjv: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
translations.asv: Now this he spake, signifying by what manner of death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
